abstract: We report an unusual case of a 46 year old diagnosed with follicular lymphoma within an ovarian teratoma. She sought medical attention due to menorrhagia, but was otherwise well. Positron Emission Tomography (PET) scanning demonstrated stage III disease, and she was treated with combination chemotherapy to complete metabolic remission on her end of treatment PET scan.
abstract_ja: 46歳女性が濾胞性リンパ腫を卵巣奇形腫内に認めた稀な症例を報告する。過多月経を主訴に受診したが、他に症状はなかった。陽電子放射断層撮影(PET)では病期IIIと判明した。併用化学療法を施行し、治療終了時のPETで代謝的完全寛解を得た。
